Our Story

About केशर अमृततुल्य

A journey of tradition, taste, and trust that has transformed into India's most loved Gud Tea brand.

The Gud Tea Revolution

Vision: To revolutionize the way the world sees tea, turning every cup into a symbol of success. We aim to empower entrepreneurs to build their future with organic, authentic beverages. Together, we'll create a community where tea means more than just a drink — it's a pathway to growth.

Mission: We are committed to offering organic, authentic beverages that promote health and wellness. Our goal is to bring these quality drinks to every home and business, creating opportunities for aspiring entrepreneurs. Through honesty, care, and dedication, we empower individuals to build successful franchises and achieve financial freedom.

Core Values: At the heart of our brand are values that guide everything we do — Keen-eyed, Empowerment, Sustainability, Honesty, Authenticity, and Reliability. These values are the foundation of our business, helping us grow with integrity, inspire others, and build lasting trust in every sip.

Why Gud Tea?

Health Benefits of Gud Tea

Gud (Jaggery) is not just a sweetener — it's a health booster. Discover why millions are switching from sugar to gud.

🩸

Purifies Blood

Gud helps in purifying blood and improving hemoglobin levels. Regular consumption can help prevent anemia and boost overall blood health.

🦴

Rich in Minerals

Jaggery is packed with essential minerals like iron, magnesium, potassium, and calcium — nutrients that refined sugar completely lacks.

🍯

Aids Digestion

Gud activates digestive enzymes and helps in proper digestion. It prevents constipation and cleanses the digestive system naturally.

⚡

Instant Energy

Unlike sugar that gives a sudden spike and crash, gud provides sustained energy release — keeping you active longer without the crash.

🛡️

Boosts Immunity

The antioxidants and minerals in gud strengthen the immune system, helping your body fight infections and diseases naturally.

❤️

Heart Healthy

Gud helps maintain proper blood pressure and reduces the risk of heart diseases. It's a heart-friendly alternative to refined sugar.

How It Works

Franchise Process

Simple steps to start your own केशर अमृततुल्य franchise outlet.

01

Initial Inquiry

Share your complete information or ask our representative any doubts. If you have a shop as per company requirements, send photo, location, and video.

  • Submit franchise inquiry form
  • Share shop details and photos
  • Ask questions to our team
  • Get preliminary approval
02

Token & Booking

Deposit ₹10,000 token amount in company account. After token, our team visits your location and provides complete information.

  • Pay ₹10,000 token amount
  • Team visits your location
  • Submit Aadhar, PAN, 2 photos
  • Submit shop light bill
03

Payment & Setup

After booking, pay ₹3 lakhs. Company sends complete setup within 10-12 days. Full payment required before opening.

  • Pay ₹3,00,000 after booking
  • Setup dispatched in 10-12 days
  • Complete payment before opening
  • Schedule opening date
04

Opening & Kickstart

After setup installation and discussion with company, your grand opening happens. Kickstart your successful franchise journey!

  • Setup installation at shop
  • 3 days free tea for customers
  • Grand opening celebration
  • Start earning from day one

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about our franchise opportunity.

What is the investment required for the franchise?+
The franchise package costs ₹2,55,000 + GST. You need to pay a ₹10,000 token amount to start the process. After booking, pay ₹3,00,000 and the company sends complete setup within 10-12 days. Full payment is required before opening.
How much space is required for the outlet?+
A minimum of 100 sq ft space is required. The shop should be near a railway station, bus stop, or high footfall area. A location with high visibility and regular customer traffic. The shop should be on ground floor (no stairs) and visible from a distance.
Do you provide training and ongoing support?+
Yes, absolutely. We provide comprehensive training covering tea preparation, customer service, inventory management, and business operations. Additionally, you receive ongoing operational support, marketing assistance, and regular performance reviews.
What is the expected ROI timeline?+
While we cannot guarantee specific returns as business performance depends on location and operations, most of our franchise partners achieve operational breakeven within 6-12 months. We provide realistic projections based on your location during the consultation.
Can I operate the franchise alongside my current job?+
Yes, many of our franchise partners operate their outlets semi-passively by hiring a trained manager. Our simplified operations model makes it possible to manage the business with minimal daily involvement once properly set up.
What makes Gud Tea different from regular tea?+
Gud Tea uses pure jaggery (gud) instead of refined sugar. Jaggery is rich in minerals, aids digestion, and provides a more authentic, traditional taste. It's healthier, more natural, and appeals to the growing health-conscious consumer base.
Do you help with location selection?+
Yes, our team provides complete location analysis and selection support. We evaluate footfall, competition, demographics, and visibility to help you choose the best location for maximum success.
What is the franchise agreement duration?+
Our standard franchise agreement is for 5 years, with renewal options. We believe in long-term partnerships and offer favorable terms for renewals to successful franchise partners.
What is included in the franchise package?+
The ₹2,55,000 + GST package includes: 8ft service counter, branded chair, digital menu board, table (1.5x1.5), 4 chairs, acrylic frame board (4x8), cooler board, menu board, tea benefit print, 6 posters, brand mascot, steel kadai, 2 steel pans, 2 glasses, 24 printed ceramic cups, induction stove, gas lighter, parcha, and tawa.
How much profit can I make?+
Tea sells at ₹10 with a making cost of ₹5, giving ₹5 profit per cup. 100 cups/day = ₹500 profit, 500 cups/day = ₹2,500 profit, 1,000 cups/day = ₹5,000 profit. More tea sold = more profit. Shop rent, light bill, and salary are covered in 45 rupees, rest is your profit.
Can I operate this alongside my current job?+
Yes! You only need 2 people to run the shop. The owner can manage operations while continuing their current job. The business model is designed for easy management with minimal daily involvement once set up.
What documents are required for booking?+
You need: Aadhar Card, PAN Card, 2 Passport Photos, and Shop Light Bill. After submitting these documents and paying the token amount, the company team visits your location and provides complete setup within 10-12 days.
